Headline: Closure - Stoke College, Suffolk
Info: Stoke College, a historic independent day and boarding school, has announced it will permanently close at the end of the current term due to severe financial pressures exacerbated by the introduction of VAT on school fees.

Headline: Merger - Saltney Ferry and Saltney Wood Primary Schools (State), Flintshire
Info: Flintshire County Council has moved plans to merge Saltney Ferry and Saltney Wood primary schools into the final statutory objection phase, despite significant opposition from parents regarding safety and the closure of Saltney Ferry.

Headline: Leadership - All Saints Catholic College (State), London
Info: Andrew O'Neill is ending his secondment as a Department for Education policy adviser early to return to his role as executive headteacher at All Saints Catholic College in west London.

Headline: Closure - Edinburgh Primary School (State), London
Info: Waltham Forest Council has proposed the closure of Edinburgh Primary School, which is currently operating at just 17 per cent capacity due to dwindling pupil numbers across London, with the site potentially being repurposed for SEND provision.

Headline: Merger - Aldro School, Surrey
Info: Aldro School in Surrey has announced it will merge into the Radley Schools Group in February 2027, joining a growing partnership of independent prep schools to share expertise and resources.
